# Giftora — Online Gift Shop India

## About
Giftora is an online gift shop based in Delhi, India. We offer same-day gift delivery across Delhi NCR and express delivery across India. Our products include cakes, flowers, teddy bears, clothes, shoes, sunglasses, belts, plants, toys, and gift combos.

Same-day delivery in Delhi NCR (Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad). Express delivery across India.
